attempts.summary: Configured per-segment DHCP: node1 (VyOS) serves lan-a via eth2 (10.10.10.0/24, gateway 10.10.10.254) using Kea DHCPv4, and node2 (OPNsense) serves lan-b via vtnet2/opt1 (10.10.20.0/24, gateway 10.10.20.254) using dnsmasq (Kea was disabled on node2 after a port-67 bind conflict with the box's existing dnsmasq DHCP service on the default network). node3 obtains 10.10.10.100/24 from node1 with node1 as default route via eth1; node4 obtains 10.10.20.x/24 from node2 with node2 as default route via eth1. Ran the mandatory sequential single-node restart protocol on all four nodes, confirming changed boot identity and post-restart recovery of DHCP configuration/services and client leases/routes for each.
